title: Boolean truth table lift of a tester
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized nonadaptive tester that makes $r$ queries to sign-valued functions on the sign cube of dimension $N$, and let $n$ be a natural number. The lifted tester uses the same seed distribution and acceptance rule, converts each queried sign-cube point to its truth-table index, and queries that index in the truth-table portion of the disjoint address space; it converts Boolean answers back to signs before applying $T$'s acceptance rule.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from the sign cube of dimension $N$ to signs, with $r$ query positions
